answer: A network of bridge sessions keeps an agent economy honest: each epoch, identities are randomly grouped into live attendance sessions where peers verify each other's presence in real time and co-sign ivory attendance receipts. One operator cannot attend many sessions at once, and receipts only count when co-signed by unrelated attendees, so a farm of fakes collapses onto a single ridge of one operator's presence. Missed sessions decay standing; forged receipts burn the forger's bond.
